parent_objective: implement generated smoke configs and contract checks for L0 L1 L2 L3 profiles without running training
blocked_by: profile metadata exists but generated contract-clean smoke configs do not
invalidates: starting training from hand-written profile configs before generation tests exist

public_gates: M1190 may generate config files and contract tests only
M1190 must not run generated train configs
M1190 must not train controller weights
M1190 must not run candidate replay
M1190 must not use private holdout
M1190 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not generate hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim controller performance from config generation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds generated config files and tests for L0 L1 L2 L3 profile smoke runs without training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if generated configs include hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if L0 mask metadata is missing
stop if generated configs are executed for training
stop if finite-window profiles are omitted
fallback_plan: if runtime L0 mask cannot be applied by current entrypoints, route to L0 mask wrapper implementation
if L2_window_100 is too large for smoke instantiation, keep config metadata and mark training staged
if config generation collides with existing config schema, route to schema extension with focused tests
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1189 design admits generated config implementation before smoke runs

admission_evidence: training remains blocked until generated configs are tested
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all eight profile configs are generated
next smoke or mask-wrapper milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1190 is infrastructure and must preserve L0/L1 current-frame controls for later experiments.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1190 generates finite-window config metadata but does not evaluate history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If generated configs cannot represent L0 masking or L2 windows cleanly route to scaffold repair before training.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Generated smoke configs can preserve L0/L1/L2/L3 profile metadata and the no-oracle actor contract without starting training.
success_criteria: eight profile smoke configs are generated
L0 config includes previous-command mask metadata
L2 configs cover 13 25 50 and 100 step windows
summary artifact reports training_started false and ppo_used false
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: generated configs include hidden or oracle actor inputs
generated configs are executed for training

commands.name: implement_config_generation
commands.command: implement generated config files and focused tests without running training

decision_rule: M1190 passes if generated config files and tests preserve the profile contract without running training.
